rule: The close report grew four appended remediation sections, and each re-graded the gaps in its own table against the state it found. That is the right way to append -- section 9 says earlier text stays as written -- but it left the final per-gap state recoverable only by reading four tables in order and letting the later ones win. The sign-off review measured the consequence: the fourth table calls G7 and G8 open with a named blocker while the first and third had already closed all three of their entries. This file is the one place the final state of each gap lives, one row apiece, and the gate below asserts the report's last table says exactly what it says. A reader who opens only this file has the answer; a reader who opens only the last table gets the same answer, because the two cannot disagree.
why_the_report_is_not_the_ledger: A report is a record of passes, in the order they ran. A ledger is a record of state, as it now is. Collapsing the two is what produced the drift: an appended table that re-grades only the gaps its own pass touched is correct about them and silently stale about the rest. So the ledger holds every gap on every pass, the report's final table is derived-checked against it, and a pass that closes a gap without moving its row here fails a gate rather than a reader.
how_a_row_closes: A CLOSED row names either a commit that exists in the campaign range or an umbrella amendment the umbrella actually holds -- both checked, so 'closed by amendment' cannot name an amendment nobody wrote. An OPEN row names the criterion it blocks and the blocker standing in its way, because an open gap with no blocker is a gap nobody can schedule.
why_snapshot_figures_are_not_restated_he: Every count this campaign grades itself by moves. The report's earlier sections quote the verify-ledger residue at 70/63, then 68/61, then 73/62, and each was true on its date -- so the figures are not repeated in this file at all. `live_figures` names the artifact that owns each one and the gate reads it at run time, which is the same discipline criterion 4 imposes on golden shape counts: one home, and every consumer reads the home.
